observations: Photo 0: Front cover of a green Xbox One game case for 'Control'. The title 'CONTROL' is prominent in white letters. The cover also shows a PEGI 16 rating, a Remedy Entertainment logo, and a 500 Games logo. The Xbox One logo is visible at the top.

Photo 1: Back cover of the same game case. The text 'Discover a World Unknown' is visible. The cover includes a synopsis, four gameplay screenshots, and a barcode. The PEGI 16 rating and other logos are present.
Photo 2: Side view of the game case. The title 'CONTROL' is printed vertically along the spine. The Xbox One logo is visible on the side. The barcode is visible at the bottom.
All photos show the game case held in a hand against a wooden-paneled wall. The lighting is warm, with a ceiling light visible in the background.
No disc is visible in any photo. The case appears to be in good condition with no visible cracks or damage.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the front cover with 'CONTROL' and 'XBOX ONE' clearly visible. Photo 1 and 2 confirm the back and side with 'CONTROL' and 'XBOX ONE' branding. The seller's text matches the visual evidence.
No visible signs of damage or wear on the case. The disc is not shown, but the case appears intact and undamaged, consistent with 'used' condition.
